allowed_current_claims: A consent-first pseudonymized case format exists.
The founding pilot demonstrates a 33-question adaptive branching workflow.
Uncertainty and longstanding baseline traits can be represented without forcing positive disease signals.
The repository has explicit claim ceilings and data-governance rules.
forbidden_current_claims: Simptomat has measured sensitivity or specificity.
The founding pilot is a true negative.
Repeated self-reported cases establish diagnostic accuracy.
A screening terminal authorizes treatment or delay of care.

metric_gate.reason: No independently established reference-standard cases and no frozen evaluation cohort.
unlock_requirements: predefined target condition and intended-use population
independent reference labels appropriate to the condition
separation of development and holdout cases
prospective or otherwise defensible validation design
